This report creates the sole stage-specific data entry for Step 3. It preserves
the complete prompt scaffold, applies the strict-complete construct-mean rules,
keeps all three engagement-duration variables in raw minutes, and creates
within-person deviations, between-person means, and level-specific standardized
derivatives. No prompt is aggregated to a day, no Engagement composite is
created, and no `log1p()` transformation is used.

Step 3 is a repository-only sensitivity analysis, retained for transparency
but not reported in the manuscript or supplementary materials.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(current)) current <- dirname(current)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(current, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability",
      "Step_3_Concurrent_Multilevel_Associations"
    ))))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not locate the project from its public Step directories")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop(
      "Expected only ", expected_name, " in ", path,
      "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

strict_complete_mean <- function(data, variables) {
  values <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[variables], as.numeric))
  complete <- rowSums(!is.na(values)) == length(variables)
  score <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(values))
  score[complete] <- rowMeans(values[complete, , drop = FALSE])
  score
}

safe_person_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

vif_table <- function(data, variables, level_label, model_label) {
  complete <- stats::complete.cases(data[variables])
  x <- as.data.frame(data[complete, variables, drop = FALSE])
  rows <- lapply(variables, function(target) {
    others <- setdiff(variables, target)
    fit <- stats::lm(
      stats::reformulate(others, response = target),
      data = x
    )
    r_squared <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    data.frame(
      model = model_label,
      level = level_label,
      variable = target,
      r_squared_from_other_predictors = r_squared,
      vif = 1 / (1 - r_squared),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}

condition_index <- function(data, variables) {
  complete <- stats::complete.cases(data[variables])
  correlation <- stats::cor(data[complete, variables, drop = FALSE])
  eigenvalues <- eigen(correlation, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  sqrt(max(eigenvalues) / min(eigenvalues))
}
```

```{r load-saved-results, include=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
load_saved_display <- function(path, focal_path) {

  stopifnot(

    all(c("prompt", "person", "variable_map", "standardization",
          "sample_audit", "diagnostics", "provenance") %in% names(saved)),
    is.data.frame(saved$prompt), nrow(saved$prompt) == 18810L,
    is.data.frame(saved$person), nrow(saved$person) == 209L,

  )
  provenance <- saved$provenance
  sources <- provenance$source_files
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(sources), all(c("object", "md5") %in% names(sources)))
  focal <- sources[sources$object == "dat_focal_analysis", , drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(
    nrow(focal) == 1L,
    identical(as.character(focal$md5), unname(tools::md5sum(focal_path))),
    identical(provenance$duration_treatment, "Raw minutes; no log1p in Step 3"),
    identical(provenance$scoring, c(
      Peripheral = "Mean PMU1-PMU2; require 2/2",
      Core = "Mean PMU3-PMU6; require 4/4",
      Distress = "Mean DASS1-DASS6; require 6/6"
    ))
  )
  tables <- list(
    measurement_bridge = provenance$measurement_bridge,
    source_checks = saved$diagnostics$source_checks,
    score_completeness = saved$diagnostics$score_completeness,
    standardization = saved$standardization,
    sample_audit = saved$sample_audit,
    duration_descriptives = saved$diagnostics$duration_descriptives,
    vif_diagnostics = saved$diagnostics$vif,
    condition_diagnostics = saved$diagnostics$condition_index,
    diagnostic_flags = saved$diagnostics$flags,
    variable_map = saved$variable_map
  )
  columns <- list(
    measurement_bridge = c("retained_model", "normal_termination", "admissible",
      "pmu2_between_residual_fixed_zero", "step3_score_representation"),
    source_checks = c("check", "observed", "expected", "passed"),
    score_completeness = c("variable", "observed_prompts", "missing_prompts", "participants_with_score"),
    standardization = c("variable", "within_center", "within_sd", "between_center", "between_sd"),
    sample_audit = c("sample", "prompts", "participants", "person_days"),
    duration_descriptives = c("variable", "behavior", "n_observed", "mean_minutes", "sd_minutes",
      "median_minutes", "minimum", "maximum", "zero_percent", "endpoint_300_count", "skewness", "excess_kurtosis"),
    vif_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif"),
    condition_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "condition_index"),
    diagnostic_flags = c("diagnostic", "flagged"),
    variable_map = c("role", "variable", "source_or_rule")
  )
  expected_rows <- c(1L, 8L, 6L, 6L, 2L, 3L, 16L, 4L, 4L, 13L)
  for (index in seq_along(tables)) {
    table <- tables[[index]]
    required <- columns[[index]]
    optional <- if (index == 1L) "heywood_remediation_success" else character()
    stopifnot(is.data.frame(table), nrow(table) == expected_rows[index],
              all(required %in% names(table)),
              all(names(table) %in% c(required, optional)),
              !anyDuplicated(names(table)))
  }
  bridge <- tables$measurement_bridge
  stopifnot(
    identical(as.character(bridge$retained_model), provenance$retained_measurement_model),
    provenance$retained_measurement_model %in% c("M3_2W2B", "M3b_2W2B_PMU2Residual0"),
    isTRUE(bridge$normal_termination), isTRUE(bridge$admissible),
    isTRUE(bridge$pmu2_between_residual_fixed_zero),
    all(tables$source_checks$passed),
    all(tables$score_completeness$participants_with_score == 209L),
    all(tables$sample_audit$participants == 209L),
    all(tables$standardization$within_sd > 0),
    all(tables$standardization$between_sd > 0)

}
```

# Step 3 scoring and measurement basis

The retained S2.6 Model 3 (`M3_2W2B`, the two-within/two-between
representation formerly labelled M3b) provides the measurement basis.
Its between-person `PMU2` residual remains fixed at zero in the
measurement model; Step 3 does not reproduce that latent model or extract
factor scores. Instead, it uses strict-complete unit-weighted means based on the same Peripheral/Core grouping.

```{r validate-measurement-bridge, eval=!use_saved_results}
measurement_results <- load_single_object(
  measurement_result_file,
  "fit_s2_10_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order_p2var0"
)

required_model_id <- "M3_2W2B"
m3b_diagnostic <- measurement_results$diagnostics |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == required_model_id)

# Validate the retained owner's syntax and diagnostics, not an archived
# extraction artifact. No CFA parameter is used to calculate manifest scores.
expected_measurement_syntax <- paste(
  "%WITHIN%", "pw BY p1-p2;", "cw BY p3-p6;", "pw WITH cw;",
  "%BETWEEN%", "pb BY p1-p2;", "cb BY p3-p6;", "pb WITH cb;", "p2@0;",
  sep = "\n"
)
pmu2_between_residual <- measurement_results$parsed_models[[required_model_id]]$
  parameters$unstandardized |>
  dplyr::filter(paramHeader == "Residual.Variances", toupper(param) == "P2",
                toupper(BetweenWithin) == "BETWEEN")
stopifnot(
  identical(measurement_results$model_syntax[[required_model_id]], expected_measurement_syntax),
  identical(measurement_results$variable_map$project_variable, paste0("PMU", 1:6)),
  identical(measurement_results$variable_map$theoretical_group,
            c(rep("Peripheral", 2L), rep("Core", 4L))),
  nrow(m3b_diagnostic) == 1L,
  isTRUE(m3b_diagnostic$normal_termination),
  identical(m3b_diagnostic$errors_n, 0L),
  isFALSE(m3b_diagnostic$negative_variance_flag),
  isFALSE(m3b_diagnostic$theta_warning),
  isTRUE(m3b_diagnostic$minimum_unstandardized_residual_variance == 0),
  nrow(pmu2_between_residual) == 1L,
  isTRUE(as.numeric(pmu2_between_residual$est) == 0),
  isTRUE(as.numeric(pmu2_between_residual$se) == 0)
)

measurement_bridge <- data.frame(
  retained_model = required_model_id,
  normal_termination = m3b_diagnostic$normal_termination,
  admissible = !m3b_diagnostic$negative_variance_flag && !m3b_diagnostic$theta_warning,
  pmu2_between_residual_fixed_zero = TRUE,
  step3_score_representation = "Strict-complete unit-weighted means",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```

# Load and validate the canonical prompt scaffold

```{r load-and-validate-source, eval=!use_saved_results}
dat_focal_analysis <- load_single_object(input_file, "dat_focal_analysis")

id_variables <- c("Data_ID", "Name_ID", "Day", "Time")
peripheral_items <- paste0("PMU", 1:2)
core_items <- paste0("PMU", 3:6)
distress_items <- paste0("DASS", 1:6)
duration_variables <- paste0("mu_time", 1:3)
required_variables <- c(
  id_variables,
  peripheral_items,
  core_items,
  distress_items,
  duration_variables
)

missing_variables <- setdiff(required_variables, names(dat_focal_analysis))
if (length(missing_variables)) {
  stop("Missing required variables: ", paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", "))
}

duplicate_prompt_keys <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::count(Name_ID, Day, Time, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1L)
duplicate_data_ids <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::count(Data_ID, name = "n") |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1L)
prompts_per_participant <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::count(Name_ID, name = "scheduled_prompts")
days_per_participant <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::distinct(Name_ID, Day) |>
  dplyr::count(Name_ID, name = "scheduled_days")

item_out_of_range <- sum(vapply(
  dat_focal_analysis[c(peripheral_items, core_items, distress_items)],
  function(x) sum(!is.na(x) & !(x %in% 1:5)),
  integer(1)
))
duration_out_of_range <- sum(vapply(
  dat_focal_analysis[duration_variables],
  function(x) sum(!is.na(x) & (x < 0 | x > 300)),
  integer(1)
))

stopifnot(
  nrow(dat_focal_analysis) == 18810L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID) == 209L,
  nrow(duplicate_prompt_keys) == 0L,
  nrow(duplicate_data_ids) == 0L,
  !anyNA(dat_focal_analysis[id_variables]),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis$Day)), 1:30),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis$Time)), 1:3),
  all(prompts_per_participant$scheduled_prompts == 90L),
  all(days_per_participant$scheduled_days == 30L),
  item_out_of_range == 0L,
  duration_out_of_range == 0L
)

source_checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "Scheduled prompt rows", "Participants", "Duplicate prompt keys",
    "Duplicate Data_ID values", "Days per participant",
    "Prompts per participant", "Out-of-range item cells",
    "Out-of-range duration cells"
  ),
  observed = c(
    nrow(dat_focal_analysis),
    dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID),
    nrow(duplicate_prompt_keys),
    nrow(duplicate_data_ids),
    paste(range(days_per_participant$scheduled_days), collapse = "-"),
    paste(range(prompts_per_participant$scheduled_prompts), collapse = "-"),
    item_out_of_range,
    duration_out_of_range
  ),
  expected = c("18810", "209", "0", "0", "30", "90", "0", "0"),
  passed = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Create construct means and raw-minute variables

```{r score-constructs, eval=!use_saved_results}
dat_prompt <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(required_variables)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day, Time) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Peripheral = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(peripheral_items)),
      peripheral_items
    ),
    Core = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(core_items)),
      core_items
    ),
    Distress = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(dplyr::all_of(distress_items)),
      distress_items
    ),
    InteractiveTime = as.numeric(mu_time1),
    ActiveTime = as.numeric(mu_time2),
    PassiveTime = as.numeric(mu_time3),
    Day_c = as.numeric(Day) - 15.5,
    Time_2 = as.integer(Time == 2L),
    Time_3 = as.integer(Time == 3L)
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

analysis_variables <- c(
  "Core", "Peripheral", "Distress",
  "InteractiveTime", "ActiveTime", "PassiveTime"
)

score_completeness <- data.frame(
  variable = analysis_variables,
  observed_prompts = vapply(
    dat_prompt[analysis_variables],
    function(x) sum(!is.na(x)),
    integer(1)
  ),
  missing_prompts = vapply(
    dat_prompt[analysis_variables],
    function(x) sum(is.na(x)),
    integer(1)
  ),
  participants_with_score = vapply(
    analysis_variables,
    function(variable) dplyr::n_distinct(
      dat_prompt$Name_ID[!is.na(dat_prompt[[variable]])]
    ),
    integer(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  all(dat_prompt$Peripheral[!is.na(dat_prompt$Peripheral)] >= 1),
  all(dat_prompt$Peripheral[!is.na(dat_prompt$Peripheral)] <= 5),
  all(dat_prompt$Core[!is.na(dat_prompt$Core)] >= 1),
  all(dat_prompt$Core[!is.na(dat_prompt$Core)] <= 5),
  all(dat_prompt$Distress[!is.na(dat_prompt$Distress)] >= 1),
  all(dat_prompt$Distress[!is.na(dat_prompt$Distress)] <= 5),
  all(score_completeness$participants_with_score == 209L)
)

```

# Decompose within and between components

```{r decompose-and-standardize, eval=!use_saved_results}
for (variable in analysis_variables) {
  between_name <- paste0(variable, "_B")
  within_name <- paste0(variable, "_W")
  dat_prompt[[between_name]] <- ave(
    dat_prompt[[variable]],
    dat_prompt$Name_ID,
    FUN = safe_person_mean
  )
  dat_prompt[[within_name]] <-
    dat_prompt[[variable]] - dat_prompt[[between_name]]
}

person_data <- dat_prompt |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    Name_ID,
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(paste0(analysis_variables, "_B")))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(nrow(person_data) == 209L, !anyNA(person_data))

standardization_rows <- lapply(analysis_variables, function(variable) {
  within_name <- paste0(variable, "_W")
  between_name <- paste0(variable, "_B")
  within_sd <- stats::sd(dat_prompt[[within_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
  between_values <- person_data[[between_name]]
  between_mean <- mean(between_values)
  between_sd <- stats::sd(between_values)
  if (!is.finite(within_sd) || within_sd <= 0 ||
      !is.finite(between_sd) || between_sd <= 0) {
    stop("Invalid level-specific SD for ", variable)
  }
  dat_prompt[[paste0(within_name, "_Z")]] <<-
    dat_prompt[[within_name]] / within_sd
  dat_prompt[[paste0(between_name, "_Z")]] <<-
    (dat_prompt[[between_name]] - between_mean) / between_sd
  data.frame(
    variable = variable,
    within_center = 0,
    within_sd = within_sd,
    between_center = between_mean,
    between_sd = between_sd,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
standardization <- dplyr::bind_rows(standardization_rows)

person_data <- dat_prompt |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    Name_ID,
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(
      paste0(analysis_variables, "_B"),
      paste0(analysis_variables, "_B_Z")
    )))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID) |>
  as.data.frame()

for (variable in analysis_variables) {
  within_values <- dat_prompt[[paste0(variable, "_W")]]
  within_z <- dat_prompt[[paste0(variable, "_W_Z")]]
  between_z <- person_data[[paste0(variable, "_B_Z")]]
  stopifnot(
    abs(mean(within_values, na.rm = TRUE)) < 1e-10,
    abs(mean(within_z, na.rm = TRUE)) < 1e-10,
    abs(stats::sd(within_z, na.rm = TRUE) - 1) < 1e-10,
    abs(mean(between_z)) < 1e-10,
    abs(stats::sd(between_z) - 1) < 1e-10
  )
}

```

# Define Step 3 analysis samples

S3.3 and S3.4 use the same complete-prompt sample so coefficient changes cannot
be attributed to different rows. S3.2 has its own outcome-relevant sample.

```{r define-analysis-samples, eval=!use_saved_results}
s32_variables <- c(
  "Core", "Peripheral", "InteractiveTime", "ActiveTime", "PassiveTime"
)
common_distress_variables <- c(
  "Distress", "Core", "Peripheral",
  "InteractiveTime", "ActiveTime", "PassiveTime"
)

dat_prompt$s32_sample <- stats::complete.cases(dat_prompt[s32_variables])
dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample <- stats::complete.cases(
  dat_prompt[common_distress_variables]
)

sample_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    sample = "S3.2 Engagement-Time to Core/Peripheral",
    prompts = sum(dat_prompt$s32_sample),
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(
      dat_prompt$Name_ID[dat_prompt$s32_sample]
    ),
    person_days = dplyr::n_distinct(interaction(
      dat_prompt$Name_ID[dat_prompt$s32_sample],
      dat_prompt$Day[dat_prompt$s32_sample],
      drop = TRUE
    )),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    sample = "S3.3/S3.4 common Distress sample",
    prompts = sum(dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample),
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(
      dat_prompt$Name_ID[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample]
    ),
    person_days = dplyr::n_distinct(interaction(
      dat_prompt$Name_ID[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample],
      dat_prompt$Day[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample],
      drop = TRUE
    )),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

stopifnot(
  all(sample_audit$prompts > 0L),
  all(sample_audit$participants == 209L),
  all(dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample <= dat_prompt$s32_sample)
)

```

# Duration and multicollinearity diagnostics

```{r diagnostic-audit, eval=!use_saved_results}
duration_labels <- c(
  InteractiveTime = "Interactive/message",
  ActiveTime = "Active/posting",
  PassiveTime = "Passive/browsing"
)

duration_descriptives <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  names(duration_labels),
  function(variable) {
    x <- dat_prompt[[variable]]
    described <- psych::describe(x, fast = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      variable = variable,
      behavior = unname(duration_labels[[variable]]),
      n_observed = sum(!is.na(x)),
      mean_minutes = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_minutes = stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_minutes = stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      minimum = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      maximum = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      zero_percent = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      endpoint_300_count = sum(x == 300, na.rm = TRUE),
      skewness = described$skew,
      excess_kurtosis = described$kurtosis,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
))

within_full_predictors <- c(
  "Core_W", "Peripheral_W", "InteractiveTime_W",
  "ActiveTime_W", "PassiveTime_W"
)
between_full_predictors <- c(
  "Core_B", "Peripheral_B", "InteractiveTime_B",
  "ActiveTime_B", "PassiveTime_B"
)
within_engagement_predictors <- c(
  "InteractiveTime_W", "ActiveTime_W", "PassiveTime_W"
)
between_engagement_predictors <- c(
  "InteractiveTime_B", "ActiveTime_B", "PassiveTime_B"
)

vif_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  vif_table(
    dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s32_sample, ],
    within_engagement_predictors,
    "Within", "S3.2 engagement predictors"
  ),
  vif_table(
    person_data,
    between_engagement_predictors,
    "Between", "S3.2 engagement predictors"
  ),
  vif_table(
    dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample, ],
    within_full_predictors,
    "Within", "S3.4 full predictors"
  ),
  vif_table(
    person_data,
    between_full_predictors,
    "Between", "S3.4 full predictors"
  )
)

condition_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "S3.2 engagement predictors", "S3.2 engagement predictors",
    "S3.4 full predictors", "S3.4 full predictors"
  ),
  level = c("Within", "Between", "Within", "Between"),
  condition_index = c(
    condition_index(
      dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s32_sample, ],
      within_engagement_predictors
    ),
    condition_index(person_data, between_engagement_predictors),
    condition_index(
      dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample, ],
      within_full_predictors
    ),
    condition_index(person_data, between_full_predictors)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

correlation_diagnostics <- list(
  s32_within = stats::cor(
    dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s32_sample, within_engagement_predictors]
  ),
  s32_between = stats::cor(person_data[between_engagement_predictors]),
  s34_within = stats::cor(
    dat_prompt[dat_prompt$s33_s34_sample, within_full_predictors]
  ),
  s34_between = stats::cor(person_data[between_full_predictors])
)

diagnostic_flags <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Maximum VIF exceeds 5",
    "Maximum condition index exceeds 30",
    "Posting zero percentage differs from verified 75.13 by > 0.05",
    "Unexpected duration endpoint"
  ),
  flagged = c(
    max(vif_diagnostics$vif) > 5,
    max(condition_diagnostics$condition_index) > 30,
    abs(
      duration_descriptives$zero_percent[
        duration_descriptives$variable == "ActiveTime"
      ] - 75.13
    ) > 0.05,
    any(duration_descriptives$minimum < 0) ||
      any(duration_descriptives$maximum > 300)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# Step 3 variable definitions

```{r save-and-reload, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
variable_map <- data.frame(
  role = c(
    rep("Identifier/time", 4),
    rep("Construct mean", 3),
    rep("Raw engagement-duration predictor", 3),
    rep("Nuisance covariate", 3)
  ),
  variable = c(
    id_variables,
    "Peripheral", "Core", "Distress",
    "InteractiveTime", "ActiveTime", "PassiveTime",
    "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3"
  ),
  source_or_rule = c(
    id_variables,
    "Mean PMU1-PMU2; require 2/2",
    "Mean PMU3-PMU6; require 4/4",
    "Mean DASS1-DASS6; require 6/6",
    "mu_time1 raw minutes", "mu_time2 raw minutes",
    "mu_time3 raw minutes", "Day - 15.5",
    "1 if Time = 2", "1 if Time = 3"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

source_files <- data.frame(
  role = c("Canonical focal data", "Step 2 measurement results"),
  file = c(
    "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_focal_analysis.rda",
    "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s2_10_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order_p2var0.rda"
  ),
  object = c("dat_focal_analysis", "fit_s2_10_multilevel_cfa_new_model_order_p2var0"),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(input_file, measurement_result_file))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dat_step3_concurrent <- list(
  prompt = dat_prompt,
  person = person_data,
  variable_map = variable_map,
  standardization = standardization,
  sample_audit = sample_audit,
  diagnostics = list(
    source_checks = source_checks,
    score_completeness = score_completeness,
    duration_descriptives = duration_descriptives,
    vif = vif_diagnostics,
    condition_index = condition_diagnostics,
    correlations = correlation_diagnostics,
    flags = diagnostic_flags
  ),
  provenance = list(
    generated_by = paste0(
      "Step_3_Concurrent_Multilevel_Associations/",
      "S3_1_PrepareConcurrentData.Rmd"
    ),
    output_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step3_concurrent.rda",
    source_files = source_files,
    retained_measurement_model = required_model_id,
    measurement_bridge = measurement_bridge,
    duration_treatment = "Raw minutes; no log1p in Step 3",
    scoring = c(
      Peripheral = "Mean PMU1-PMU2; require 2/2",
      Core = "Mean PMU3-PMU6; require 4/4",
      Distress = "Mean DASS1-DASS6; require 6/6"
    )
  )
)

expected_components <- c(
  "prompt", "person", "variable_map", "standardization",
  "sample_audit", "diagnostics", "provenance"
)
stopifnot(
  identical(names(dat_step3_concurrent), expected_components),
  nrow(dat_step3_concurrent$prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(dat_step3_concurrent$person) == 209L,
  !anyDuplicated(dat_step3_concurrent$prompt[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")])
)

save(dat_step3_concurrent, file = output_file, compress = "xz", version = 3)

verified_step3 <- load_single_object(output_file, "dat_step3_concurrent")
stopifnot(
  identical(names(verified_step3), expected_components),
  identical(verified_step3$sample_audit, sample_audit),
  identical(verified_step3$standardization, standardization),
  identical(verified_step3$provenance$source_files, source_files),
  nrow(verified_step3$prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(verified_step3$person) == 209L
)

output_manifest <- data.frame(
  file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step3_concurrent.rda",
  top_level_object = "dat_step3_concurrent",
  components = paste(names(verified_step3), collapse = ", "),
  rows_prompt = nrow(verified_step3$prompt),
  rows_person = nrow(verified_step3$person),
  bytes = file.info(output_file)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(output_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r final-acceptance, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
acceptance <- data.frame(
  gate = c(
    "Source structure validated",
    "Constrained 2W2B measurement basis validated",
    "Strict construct means valid",
    "Raw durations retained",
    "Within/between standardization valid",
    "S3.2 sample covers 209 participants",
    "S3.3/S3.4 common sample covers 209 participants",
    "Saved RDA reloaded successfully"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(source_checks$passed),
    nrow(measurement_bridge) == 1L && measurement_bridge$admissible,
    all(score_completeness$participants_with_score == 209L),
    all(duration_descriptives$minimum >= 0) &&
      all(duration_descriptives$maximum <= 300),
    all(standardization$within_sd > 0) &&
      all(standardization$between_sd > 0),
    sample_audit$participants[1] == 209L,
    sample_audit$participants[2] == 209L,
    file.exists(output_file) && nrow(verified_step3$prompt) == 18810L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(acceptance$passed))
```

The canonical output is
`Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step3_concurrent.rda`. S3.2-S3.4 must treat this
file as read-only and must not independently rescore the source items.
